root_cause.text: The ASoC nau8821 codec driver did not stop its pending jack-detection delayed work (`nau8821_jdet_work`) during component removal, so the workqueue could later run after the driver’s `snd_soc_component`/private data had been torn down and dereference invalid memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `nau8821_component_remove()` and calls `cancel_delayed_work_sync(&nau8821->jdet_work)` when `nau8821->jdet_active` is set, and the CVE notes that unloading the driver while jack detection work is pending can crash in `nau8821_jdet_work`/`snd_soc_dapm_disable_pin` after component removal.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add component removal cleanup to cancel active jack-detection delayed work during teardown.
intent_record.what: A new static function `nau8821_component_remove(struct snd_soc_component *component)` was added. It retrieves the driver data with `snd_soc_component_get_drvdata(component)` and, if `nau8821->jdet_active` is true, calls `cancel_delayed_work_sync(&nau8821->jdet_work)`. The function ends with an extra semicolon after the closing brace.
intent_record.how: On component removal, any pending jack-detection delayed work is synchronously canceled when jack detection is active. This prevents the work item from running after the component has been removed, avoiding use-after-free or other teardown-time race conditions.

intent_record.intent_summary: Register the nau8821 component remove callback so driver cleanup runs during component teardown.
intent_record.what: The snd_soc_component_driver structure for the nau8821 driver was updated to add a .remove callback, wiring it to nau8821_component_remove.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the component framework will now invoke nau8821_component_remove when the codec component is torn down, allowing the driver to perform its cleanup path instead of only handling probe and runtime callbacks.

grouping_result.intent: Register the nau8821 component remove callback so driver cleanup runs during component teardown.

consistency_review.core_intent: Register component teardown cleanup so nau8821 driver resources and delayed work are cleaned up during removal.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly address the root cause by adding component removal cleanup and canceling the pending jack-detection delayed work before teardown, preventing use-after-free on the codec's private data.
